Research Ready From Day One

Your global source for wash-free IVC solutions and expert services designed for the modern vivarium.

Explore our solutions

One Partner For Your Preclinical Research Needs

Innovive helps research teams move faster and more efficiently with a fully-integrated scalable ecosystem, including the industry’s only true closed-loop recycling program. From early stage biotech companies to large pharma and academic research institutions, Innovive can provide a custom solution.

Products

Disposable IVC racks, caging systems, bedding, and water
solutions for small animals.

Learn More

Inno+ Services

Your scientists weren't hired to manage operations. Scale your animal research program efficiently without increasing payroll. 

What We Offer

Closed-Loop Recycling

Innovive closed-loop cage recycling program removes your waste management issue and provides measurable environmental impact for your facility.

Explore

Global Preclinical Reach

Directly and in collaboration with our distribution partners, Innovive enables better preclinical research worldwide through scalable, sustainable vivarium solutions that support animal welfare, biosecurity, and scientific efficiency.
